name: branding-monoline-circular-o-letters-tanara-wordmark-on-brown
title: Cream 'Tanara' wordmark with rounded pill-shaped letters and open counters on dark brown
whatItIs: A dark olive-brown field with a cream wordmark 'Tanara' built from uniform-weight strokes: a T with a long crossbar, round or stadium-shaped a and n forms with open counters, and a small © mark.
whatItMeans: Warm and modern; stadium-shaped letters feel friendly and geometric.
techniques: Build letters from equal-weight stadium shapes.
Keep the counters open and round.

vocabulary.definition: A rectangle with fully rounded ends.
A constant line weight across letters.
An enclosed letter space left open in the design.
Cream and brown as a colour pair.
